text:
Samir Desai: FYI Vara Analytics submitted a one-off request: 10-month prepaid $85k credits, tiered reseller discount (30% first 2 months, 15% months 3-6), plus a 10% ongoing rev-share on net usage. They want net-45 invoicing and monthly payouts. Need quick finance + legal sign-off. cc @Nora Blake @Hector Ruiz

Nora Blake: Quick clarifier 1: is the 10% rev-share on net after platform fees? 2) Payment method? 3) Are discounts applied per invoice or against prepaid credits?

Samir Desai: Yes rev-share on net after fees. Payment via wire. Discounts should be reflected as contra-revenue on the first invoices (applied against prepaid balance). Recognition: defer $85k, recognize monthly over 10 months.

Hector Ruiz: Infra estimate: expected COGS ~ $18k over term (hosted). If partner needs SRE support add PS line in SOW.

LegalBot: Legal needs addendum capturing tiered discount windows, rev-share calc, tax withholding, and audit rights. Also include a clause preventing the reseller from reselling to restricted industries. I can draft once terms locked.

Nora Blake: Finance guardrails: (1) require reserve 25% of prepaid into GL 5301 (reseller_reserve) until monthly reconciliations; (2) cap rev-share payouts at 40% of gross margin; (3) net-45 OK for prepaid < $100k exposure with reserve. Approving conditional on KYC and wire proof.

Samir Desai: Vara agreed to KYC + wire proof today. I'll attach SOW and payment confirmation to billing ticket. billing-bot please create plan_id 'vara-tiered-v1' and map GL 5301.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-5177: "Vara tiered discount + rev-share" - tasks: create plan_id 'vara-tiered-v1', invoice template supporting contra-revenue lines, GL mapping 5301. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-5177

Nora Blake: Treasury confirms exposure acceptable with 25% reserve. Approving: tiered discount (30% first 2 months, 15% months 3-6) applied as contra-revenue, net-45 invoicing, prepaid recognition monthly, rev-share reserve 25%, monthly payouts, cap rev-share to 40% gross margin. :white_check_mark:

Hector Ruiz: Note PS risk in SOW; if they request dedicated integration we'll invoice it separately.

Samir Desai: Thanks all 1 Rana/legal: please loop Partnerships for addendum review. I'll attach docs to BILL-5177 and ping once done. billing-bot please tag ticket 'vara-tiered-v1' and set priority medium.
